messages:
Maya P.: Procurement at NordBank asked for a concise EU-only processing summary + subprocessor CSV they can attach to the contract. They want: one diagram, subproc list with residency, KMS options, and a one-paragraph legal assurance. Deadline: Friday COB.

Ravi K.: I'll produce the diagram. Public-safe version: edge LB (eu) -> inference cluster (eu GPUs) -> ephemeral KV cache (eu) -> artifacts bucket (eu, encrypted) -> optional backup (customer opt-in). Will remove hostnames and internal IDs.

Nora T.: I'll assemble the subprocessor CSV. Plan columns: name, category, eu-region(s), data types touched, purpose, compliance URL, evidence_link. Will mark any vendor hosted outside EU as "opt-in only".

Eli G.: Telemetry note: default metrics/aggregates are processed in eu-west1. Error notifications go to AlertCo EU endpoints. Support traces are redacted: no prompt text, stack frames hashed, session IDs ephemeral. Retention: metrics 30d, debug traces 90d. Will paste vendor pages.

Maya P.: Add KMS options in the doc: Redwood-managed (default, EU), customer-managed CMK in EU KMS, enterprise HSM (partner/on-prem). Also call out that cross-region backups require explicit customer consent in SOW.

Ravi K.: Suggest a one-paragraph legal line: "For Customer accounts configured to the EU processing region, Redwood will store and process Customer Data within EU jurisdictions unless Customer expressly enables cross-region features. Redwood will not use Customer Data to improve models. The subprocessor roster is maintained and updated with prior notice as required by contract." I can flag for Legal review.

Nora T.: Sample CSV rows I'll include: CloudHostEU, Hosting, eu-west1, compute+object, hosting, https://cloudhost.example/eu-compliance, https://evidence.example/cloud-eu; MetricsCoEU, Observability, eu-west1, aggregated metrics, monitoring, https://metricsco.example/compliance, retention policy link; AlertsEU, Alerting, eu-west*, alerts only, https://alerts.example/eu.

Eli G.: One more operations clarity: for PROD customers we enforce region pinning and explicit routing policies; for short-term POCs we don’t auto-fallback to non-EU capacity unless customer authorizes it. Include that sentence.

OpsBot: Reminder: attach evidence checklist for procurement: subproc CSV, one-page diagram PNG, KMS options blurb, retention/evidence links, legal paragraph.

Maya P.: Sounds good. Owners: Ravi = diagram PNG, Nora = CSV + evidence links, Eli = telemetry vendor links + redact note, Legal = final signoff on paragraph. Delivery target: Friday COB. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
